objects: the exact current top cards of that player's library
one new zone incarnation per moved physical card
state_reads: current library size and top identities
timing: spell targets are selected on cast, triggered targets on placement, and every direct player target is revalidated immediately before resolution
targets: one player or one opponent through the existing public player-target schema
choices: none in the represented mandatory slice
hidden_information: library order remains hidden before commitment
only cards whose actual destination is public are named in the public Mill journal
apnap: zone-change triggers from the simultaneous Mill result enter the ordinary trigger batch
replacement_effects: every requested graveyard move enters the canonical destination-replacement batch before the first mutation
control_change: the affected player is captured from the controller or revalidated direct target
zone_change: a short library mills as many cards as possible
the typed result records each actual destination and new logical incarnation
source_leaves: an already-created spell or triggered ability resolves independently of source departure

variants: target player mills a fixed count
target opponent mills a fixed count
fixed Mill followed by an independently typed sibling effect

implementation.component: quorune.milling, quorune.compiler.mill_templates, quorune.rules.mill_capability_shapes, quorune.semantic_runtime.generic.MillHandler, and the canonical zone-transition owner
implementation.supported_slice: One mandatory positive fixed-count controller, target-player, or target-opponent Mill instruction with no linked result consumer.

known_blockers: Mill costs, optional Mill, dynamic, multiplied, half-library, and state-derived quantities remain unsupported
each-player, each-opponent, any-number-of-targets, and repeated Mill need a multiplayer batch owner
linked cards-milled-this-way consumers under CR 701.17c-d need typed actual-result bindings
graveyard-order-sensitive interactions remain excluded while CR 404.3 is blocked
aggregate library, graveyard, replacement, and zone-trigger coverage remains incomplete
